title: Unimoni Student Stars 2023
description: This merit-based scholarship is for students pursuing Business, Engineering, Science, and other streams at universities in USA, Canada, and numerous other countries. It offers a maximum scholarship of Rs 3,00,000 to 5 selected students.

title: Young Women in Public Affairs Awards
organization: Young Women in Public Affairs Awards
description: This merit-based scholarship is exclusively for young women pursuing higher education in Business, Engineering, Science, and related fields at global universities. It offers a scholarship of up to Rs 4,71,899 (5,000 USD) to 37 deserving recipients.

title: Robert S. McNamara Fellowships Program
description: This merit-based fellowship program is designed for individuals pursuing studies primarily in Business at universities across Afghanistan, Albania, and 173 other countries. It provides substantial financial support up to Rs 42,36,523 (44,888 USD) to a varying number of fellows.

title: GlobalScholarships.com $3,000 Scholarship
description: This scholarship is open to students based on both need and merit, pursuing various fields like Business, Engineering, and Science at universities in USA, Canada, and many other countries. A scholarship of Rs 2,83,140 (3,000 USD) is awarded to one student.

title: Amberscholar Scholarship
description: This need and merit-based scholarship is for students studying Business, Engineering, Science, and other streams at universities in Canada, Germany, and three other specified countries. It offers a significant scholarship amount of up to Rs 47,12,953 (50,000 USD) to a varying number of students.

title: HEST 2025 - New Study Abroad Scholarship
description: This need-based scholarship is available for the 2025 intake for students planning to study abroad in fields such as Business, Engineering, and Science. It is applicable for all universities in USA, Canada, and over 238 other countries, providing financial support for their studies.

title: Al Qasimi Foundation Doctoral Research Grants
description: This grant is for Indian PhD students whose research is focused on public policy or social science in the UAE. It covers flights, furnished housing in Ras Al Khaimah for a year, and provides a stipend to support fieldwork. Applicants need an IELTS score of 6.5 and a research proposal approved by their home university.
